authority: exact literals in the retained 0964 benchmark harness source; post-capture report roots must match these values byte-for-byte

exact_values.performance_claim: none; raw phase timings describe this explicit in-memory harness and do not claim OS thread counts, speedup, allocation behavior, or physical I/O
exact_values.phase_scope: ingress_ns is the direct SourceBackedEditor constructor; edit_commit_ns is selector staging, cell sets, and MultiCommit::commit; publication_ns is publish_multi_commit_to_stream plus returned MultiSnapshot drop; commit_drop_ns is MultiCommit drop; total_ns starts at the constructor and ends after commit teardown
exact_values.setup_scope: deterministic corpus and expected output construction, frozen source/output/semantic oracles, SourceCacheLimits and output ceiling, one untimed admission preflight, inverse patch, fresh OwnedSource clone, finite managed context, and sink capacity reservation are outside measured phases
exact_values.timing_scope: with fresh finite managed context prepared outside the clock, the timer begins at SourceBackedEditor construction and covers edit/commit, source-backed publication, returned snapshot drop, and commit/package worker-pool teardown; precomputed source/cache/context setup and bounded sink allocation are outside
exact_values.verification_scope: exact output bytes, immutable fixture source hash, output/semantic hashes, workbook verification, sink bounds, CpuTasks/OutputBytes counters, and post-drop Memory/Workers/IoConcurrency/Objects checks run outside timers; the untimed admission preflight verifies an actual managed-commit inverse (preflight_actual_commit_inverse_verified=true), while each timed sample applies the precomputed inverse patch only as a fixture to its published bytes (fixture_inverse_restored_exact_source)
